deepdives.title: GTA6
deepdives.body:
20 mentions found across 12 unique accounts, but 45% traced back to a single account with roughly 100 followers — not organic spread. Most-quoted "top voices" leaned promotional ("beautiful chart trajectories," countdown framing to a specific date); the one account with genuinely large reach (@CryptoGodJohn, 915K followers) was the most neutral, referencing the real Netflix/trailer news event rather than price talk.

On-chain: mint authority revoked, freeze authority revoked, LP locked 99% — the basics are clean. But private wallets hold an adjusted 27.3% of supply — inferred from wallet behaviour, not confirmed. Entry-flow analysis showed net outflow and seller-dominant pressure — price moved up more than actual net buying justified, and the liquidity pool has been shrinking (-5.3% over ~70 hours). VWAP read: price sitting 21.6% above VWAP with no strong support underneath — thin.

Read: clean contract fundamentals sitting on top of manufactured-looking hype and weakening flow. Not a confirmed rug — no evidence of malicious contract code — but the mention volume that would normally read as "organic buzz" mostly wasn't, and the price action isn't backed by real net buying pressure right now.
